question: 28P3 is divisible by 11 . What is the value of P ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Divisibility by 11: Sum of digits at odd positions − Sum of digits at even positions = 0 or 11k.

Sum of digits at odd positions (3 + 8) = 11.

Sum of digits at even positions (P + 2) = P + 2.

Difference: 11 − (P + 2) = 0 ⇒ 9 − P = 0 ⇒ P = 9.

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number = 28P3

Divisible by 11

**Formula Used:**

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference of the sum of digits at odd places and the sum of digits at even places is 0, 11, 22, etc.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of digits at odd places (from right) = 3 + 8 = 11

⇒ Sum of digits at even places (from right) = P + 2

⇒ Difference = 11 − (P + 2)

⇒ 11 − P − 2 = 0 (for the smallest multiple of 11)

⇒ 9 − P = 0

⇒ P = 9

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility by 11 Rule

A number is divisible by 11 if the alternating sum of its digits is divisible by 11. Example: For abcd, (d + b) − (c + a) = 0 or 11k.

Divisibility by 3 and 9

A number is divisible by 3 (or 9) if the sum of all its digits is divisible by 3 (or 9).

Divisibility by 4

A number is divisible by 4 if the last two digits of the number are divisible by 4 or are both zeros.
